real_defects.issue: A sole trader's 13-18 month period capped the AIA and writing-down allowances at 12 months (input allowed up to 18): an 18-month period with £2m of second-hand kit got a £1m AIA instead of £1.5m (CAA 2001 s51A(6), s56(3); HMRC CA23085). A company period over 12 months was accepted though a CT accounting period is at most 12 months.

The £1,000 small pools limit was never scaled for the period's length (s56A; HMRC CA23225): a 6-month period wrote off an £800 pool in full instead of 14% x 6/12 = £56, and the page said the pool 'can be written off in full'.
A profit field holding only spaces read as £0 profit (Number('  ') = 0), so any claim was flagged as creating a loss.
